site_program: Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital + 37 Military Hospital, Accra
screening_population: live-born <48 h including preterm and NICU infants if not receiving supplemental oxygen
screening_timing_raw: 74% screened <24 h; median age approximately 19-21 h by CHD group
screening_algorithm_raw: modified AAP algorithm; failed screens clinically monitored/stabilized and referred for cardiology exam/echo
study_target_definition_raw: authors classify 9 of 19 CHD as critical using broader first-year-intervention concept
harmonized_cchd_cases_among_final_failed: 2 definite among imaged; 2 pre-echo deaths unresolved
diagnosis_categories_raw: source critical CHD9; noncritical CHD10; false positives8; two deaths before echo
diagnosis_counts_raw: 29 failed; 27 imaged = critical CHD9 + noncritical CHD10 + false positives8; two died before echo. Among false positives main article identifies myocarditis1 + PPHN1; six others require supplement for etiologic classification.
individual_diagnoses: critical cases: mitral atresia/VSD; complex dextrocardia/malposed great vessels; TGA; supramitral membrane/common atrium/hypoplastic LV; tricuspid atresia; TOF+severe PS; TGA+VSD+PS; HLHS; TOF+CAVSD. Ten noncritical lesions listed individually in source table.
lesion_mapping_status: Only standalone TGA case3 and HLHS case8 are definite harmonized CCHD. Complex TGA case7 is not simple; TOF/PS are conditional without <=28d event; other source-critical anatomies are not automatic target. Among 27 imaged cases, known harmonized-negative denominator=25. Two pre-echo deaths may be CCHD or CCHD-negative, yielding denominator 25-27.
management_actionability_evidence: Failed infants were monitored/stabilized while awaiting echo, but this generic pathway is not diagnosis-specific actionability. Seventeen imaged CHD cases re-enter/stay in denominator and are CAN-U17; myocarditis1 and PPHN1 are CAN-U2 because no case-specific qualifying consequence is reported. Six false positives remain etiologically unclassified in recovered main text. No Strict event assigned by diagnosis alone.
poolability_reason: mixed NICU/well-baby cohort is inseparable; harmonized denominator bounded by two pre-echo deaths and terminal ascertainment <90%
source_full_text_provenance: Yao NA et al. BMJ Glob Health. 2026;11(1):e022157. PMID 41605545; PMCID PMC12853520; DOI 10.1136/bmjgh-2025-022157.
extraction_notes: Confirmed imaged harmonized-negative subset n=25: CAN-U at least19 and unknown6. If both pre-echo deaths are harmonized-negative, denominator rises to27 and unknown to8. Strict0 across admissible mappings; Expanded at least19/25-27. R053/NR048 are one Ghana cohort; companion adds no weight.

screening_population: systematic POS implementation across maternity services; exact nursery/NICU contribution not separable in report
screening_timing_raw: approximately six months of full implementation; early discharge noted as challenge
screening_algorithm_raw: SIBEN consensus pulse-oximetry implementation for neonatal hypoxemia/CCHD detection
study_target_definition_raw: no CCHD among four hypoxemic final-positive infants
diagnosis_categories_raw: hypoxemic infants; no CCHD; etiologic diagnoses not reported
diagnosis_counts_raw: 4 hypoxemic infants; all required supplemental oxygen and had good outcomes; no CCHD
lesion_mapping_status: No CCHD identified; all four remain in denominator. Because etiologic diagnoses are absent, they cannot be assigned a CAN diagnosis class solely from oxygen treatment.
management_actionability_evidence: All four required supplemental oxygen and had good outcomes. This is strong management-only evidence, but Phase4.5 explicitly cautioned against converting it automatically into confirmed actionable diagnoses; retained as UNKNOWN_WITH_TREATMENT in notes rather than Strict CAN.
poolability_reason: management-only evidence is informative for a broader clinical-consequence sensitivity analysis, but the CAN diagnosis endpoint is not ascertainable
